title: Sue Ann NDE 7632
content: In the ambulance, I remember telling the emergency medical technician (EMT) while on the way to the hospital, that 'I'm dying; I can feel that I'm going.' She yelled, 'no, no, no, you’re not! Stay with me!' I even heard the machine I was connected start beeping as I flat-lined. The next thing I know, I'm in a bright light but it doesn't sting my eyes. Even the ground was light. I looked to my right and saw three identical, humanoid beings but they were very old. They seemed to be connected as one. They wore a robe with flower petals and feathers that were falling around them. My spirit spoke for me telepathically to the beings. My soul knew the questions I needed to ask, which centered on why I have endured so much heartache and hardships. He answered telepathically, 'You have chosen every path you have taken; everything that has happened was directly related to your choices. You will rejoice in every experience one day, but it isn't your time yet.' Next, I was in a cathedral and surrounded by people I couldn't recognize because my own light was too bright. They all began to talk at once. I yelled, 'One at a time! I don't understand you.' Then I woke up. The EMT was giving me CPR. I remember my first breath because it was the hardest thing I have ever done, taking in air for the first time after being dead. My doctor was amazed showing me where I flat lined. He said 95% of people don't come back from being gone as long as I was. Even more amazing, I had no organ damage. I was only gone 20 seconds. I remained in critical condition for three days but have made a full recovery.",When I was before the three beings. I'm certain I was before God.,More consciousness and alertness than normal, I was experiencing telepathy and understanding of things so clearly.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw "three identical, humanoid beings" that "were very old," "seemed to be connected as one," and "wore a robe with flower petals and feathers that were falling around them." Experiencer adds: "I'm certain I was before God."

environment.environment_other_detail: In a "bright light" that "doesn't sting my eyes"; "Even the ground was light." Later: "in a cathedral" surrounded by people.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Flatline in ambulance; bright light/ground of light; encounter with three beings; later in a cathedral with many people talking; return with CPR/first breath.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE or tunnel described; experience begins with bright light, then beings/telepathic exchange, then cathedral scene, then return during CPR.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Three identical very old humanoid beings that "seemed to be connected as one" and wore robes with "flower petals and feathers" falling around them; experiencer reports her own light was too bright to recognize the surrounding people in the cathedral.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I'm dying; I can feel that I'm going." "You have chosen every path you have taken; everything that has happened was directly related to your choices. You will rejoice in every experience one day, but it isn't your time yet." "Even the ground was light."
